verdict.rationale: Asana documents token creation for API auth and pre-registering MCP apps in the developer console. It also claims every agent has its own identity, scoped permissions, audit trail and constraints, managed from the admin console. However, the scoped-permission claim covers Asana's own AI Teammates, and nothing shows that API tokens or MCP/OAuth apps can be limited to least-privilege scopes for an external agent. Missing for 10: documented OAuth/token scopes or permission granularity for API credentials, the ability to restrict a credential to specific workspaces/projects/actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
